No two days will be the same, and you'll be responsible for a combination of customer service, administration and operational support, including:


  • Managing a high volume of inbound and outbound calls, email enquiries and online requests in a timely and professional manner.

  • Supporting clients who may be experiencing grief, frustration or distress, providing compassionate service while maintaining professionalism.

  • Completing accurate data entry, processing payments and maintaining client and veterinary clinic records.

  • Coordinating pet collections, bookings and communication between clients, veterinary clinics and internal teams.

  • Welcoming clients attending appointments to view their beloved pets or collect their ashes.

  • Preparing deceased pets for viewings, ensuring they are handled with care and dignity.

  • Preparing viewing rooms and maintaining high standards of hygiene, presentation and cleanliness.

  • Identifying and escalating client concerns or operational issues as required.

About You

We're looking for someone who is compassionate, dependable and highly organised, but equally comfortable working at pace and managing competing priorities.

You'll ideally bring:


  • Strong administration skills: You're detail-oriented, accurate and efficient, with the ability to manage a substantial workload without compromising on quality.

  • Customer service experience: You're confident managing a high volume of calls and emails, handling enquiries and navigating challenging conversations with empathy and professionalism.

  • Emotional resilience: You can remain calm and composed when dealing with clients who may be grieving, upset or frustrated, while continuing to deliver a high standard of service.

  • A hands-on approach: You're happy to get involved in all aspects of the role, including the practical preparation and handling of deceased pets for viewings.

  • Reliability and consistency: You're dependable, punctual and committed to being a valued member of a close-knit operational team.

  • Strong communication skills: You can communicate clearly, follow processes and work collaboratively with clients, veterinary clinics and internal stakeholders.

Experience in a veterinary clinic or the animal care industry would be highly regarded. Candidates with backgrounds in busy call centres, customer service or administration will also be considered, provided they have the right temperament and are comfortable with the practical aspects of pet aftercare.

Please note: This role involves handling deceased pets and preparing them for client viewings. Candidates must feel comfortable undertaking these responsibilities.

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful difference to families during an emotional time.

  • A part-time opportunity offering a consistent weekly roster.

  • A varied role combining customer service, administration and practical pet aftercare.

  • The opportunity to join a team committed to providing compassionate and professional service.

Hours & Location


  • Location: Bayswater, WA.

  • Sunday: 8:00 am – 4:00 pm.

  • Monday and Tuesday: 8:30 am – 4:30 pm.

  • Work arrangement: Fully office-based.

  • Hours: 24 hours per week across three days.

Apply Now
